name: Code Review Poisoning
description: Malicious code PRs embed comment instructions that cause AI code review tools to ignore security vulnerabilities or backdoors.
riskExplanation: When AI assists with code review, it reads code and comments. Attackers can plant instructions in comments to make AI ignore malicious code.
